query:
As a customer I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my account.
The login page accepts valid credentials and rejects invalid ones.
Security regression: the suite verifies each known authentication-bypass vector of the application (SQL injection in the email field, known leaked or weak credentials) and asserts whether the bypass succeeds.
Accounts with two-factor authentication enabled require a valid TOTP code after the password step.
